notes: Route: robots.txt permissive for non-Googlebot (Sitemap: https://www.jawapos.com/sitemap.xml) -> sitemap.xml index -> post-index.xml. KEY: post-index.xml only lists post-1..post-10.xml, but the server keeps serving post-11, post-12, ... post-143.xml, strictly descending by lastmod, 100 URLs per file; walk N=1.. until a file's newest lastmod < 2026-09-25 (post-143 newest = 2026-09-24, stop). Result: 13915 unique URLs, all 31 days covered, per-day 250-601 (2026-09-30: 601, 2026-10-10: 406, 2026-10-20: 513). Dates: every article URL embeds the publication date in its path as an 8-digit YYMMDDNNNN code (e.g. /nasional/2610240134/ = 2026-10-24); page JSON-LD datePublished is WIB local (UTC+7) whose date part matches the code exactly, and sitemap lastmod is WIB time mislabeled with a Z suffix (2026-10-24T11:56:50Z == 2026-10-24T11:56:50+07:00). The script lists the date from the URL path code (fallback: lastmod date part). Verified 4 random samples across 09-25/09-30/10-10/10-20: all 200, page datePublished date == listed date (diff 0d), 5349-5974 chars of body text. One transient 502 on post-50.xml during a run caused an early stop; fixed with retry-on-5xx (6 tries, 15/30/45/60/75/90s backoff) then reran to completion. All HTTP via polite_fetch.
